policies.title: HKSAR passports: Grenada short-visitor visa exemption
policies.summary: Grenada's current Embassy-linked nationality schedule directly lists Hong Kong as No Visa required.
conditions: Applies only to the HKSAR Passport represented by the Hong Kong code, for a short visitor entry.
Grenada's current linked schedule labels Hong Kong No Visa required; it separately defines visitor extensions and other-purpose travel outside this baseline.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment, plus final admission, remain outside scope.

policies.title: HKSAR passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Hong Kong visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies only to the HKSAR Passport represented by the Hong Kong code, for short visitor travel.
Jordan's table says a visa can be obtained on arrival for a total of 40 JOD.
Jordan directs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan and obtain a QR code before departure; restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.
